propositions: The test exhausts all 232 eligible prose units via Pandoc subprocesses (8.865s) despite needing only an existential proof that at least one eligible unit exists and at least one changes.
Exact short-circuit evaluation after observing both witnesses reduces subprocess calls from 232 to 1 and runtime from 8.829s to 0.036s while preserving identical pass/fail semantics.
The test still fails when no eligible units exist or when all eligible units render identically, confirming both existential postconditions remain binding.
Full-corpus corpus_pass1 property tests retain independent coverage and are unaffected by the short-circuit change, which is confined to this test loop.
